title: SEO / GEO
subtitle: Manage search visibility, publishing, traffic and AI monitoring.
overviewHelp: Counts include all stored runs. Brand mentions, provider citations and answer links are tracked separately.
deleteHelp: This removes the configuration. Historical monitoring records remain available.
secretHelp: Leave a stored secret blank to keep it. Use Clear stored secret to remove it. Secrets are encrypted and are never returned to the storefront.
pageHelp: Use the actual storefront path, for example /dk-en/products/iphone-15. Hreflang is a JSON object; structured data is a JSON object or array. Changes apply on the next request.
monitorHelp: Enabled monitors make paid API requests at the configured interval. New monitors start disabled. Manual runs are available for verification.
providerHelp: Responses uses standard input and web_search for ChatGPT. Chat uses messages. Chat input is reserved for compatible gateways; choose the format your endpoint supports.
evidenceHelp: Provider citations come from API annotations. Answer links are extracted from text and do not prove the page was retrieved or cited.
crawlerHelp: Crawler names are identified from User-Agent strings. These records do not verify the crawler's identity or prove inclusion in AI answers.
gsc: Search Console · 31 days, with reporting delay
indexNowHelp: Save the site URL, IndexNow enabled state and key in Settings first. Only canonical same-site URLs can be submitted. HTTP acceptance does not confirm indexing.
scanPartialFailure: {{failed}} log sources failed. Check the source's last error.
loadFailed: Unable to load data. Try refreshing.
sitemapLoadFailed: Unable to read the storefront sitemap. Check the site URL and storefront service.
saveFailed: Unable to save. Check the values and try again.
operationFailed: Operation failed. Check configuration and try again.
encryptionRequired: Configure SEO_ENCRYPTION_KEY or a secure COOKIE_SECRET on the backend.
invalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL without credentials.
invalidPath: Enter a path starting with /, without query parameters or fragments.
readOnlySetting: This value is maintained by successful submissions.
invalidBoolean: Use true or false for this setting.
invalidIndexNowKey: Use 8–128 letters, numbers or hyphens for the IndexNow key.
invalidBingXml: Enter a valid Bing users/user verification XML document.
invalidMeasurementId: Enter a GA4 measurement ID beginning with G-.
invalidVerificationCode: Enter the verification code only, without HTML tags.
cannotExposeSecret: Clear the stored secret before changing this field to public.
invalidHreflang: Use language keys and absolute HTTP or HTTPS URLs.
invalidStructuredData: Structured data must be a JSON object or array.
invalidProvider: Check the provider, model and API format.
invalidInterval: Enter a valid interval in minutes.
invalidLocale: Use a base language code such as en or zh.
absoluteLogPathRequired: Use an absolute path to a server-side Nginx log file.
logPathDenied: The log path is outside SEO_LOG_ROOTS.
logFileRequired: The log source must be a regular file.
logLineTooLarge: A log line exceeds the scan limit.
logReadFailed: Unable to read or ingest this log file. Check the path, permissions and format.
responseTooLarge: The remote response exceeded the size limit.
emptyAnswer: The provider did not return a complete answer.
interruptedRun: This run was interrupted before completion.
providerRequired: Configure this provider's API key and model first.
providerFailed: The provider request failed. Check credentials, model, URL and API format.
monitorRunning: This monitor is running. Try again after completion.
invalidSitemap: The sitemap is not valid XML or has no sitemap root.
sitemapLimit: The sitemap exceeds the scan limit.
crossOriginSitemap: The sitemap contains URLs outside the configured site.
auditFetchFailed: Unable to fetch this published resource.
indexNowSameSite: Only same-site canonical URLs without query parameters can be submitted.
indexNowRequired: Enable IndexNow and save a valid key first.
indexNowVerificationFailed: The public IndexNow key file could not be verified.
indexNowFailed: Unable to submit to IndexNow. Check site and network configuration.
googleCredentialsRequired: Configure the OAuth client ID, client secret and refresh token.
googlePropertyRequired: Configure the GA4 numeric property ID.
googleResourceRequired: Configure the Search Console property URL or sc-domain resource.
googleConnectionFailed: Unable to access this Google property. Check credentials, permissions and network.
